header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.arabic_text: رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ أَمَامَكُمْ عَقَبَةً كَؤُودًا لَا يُجَاوِزُهَا الْمُثْقِلُونَ فَأُحِبُّ أَنْ أَتَخَفَّفَ لِتِلْكَ الْعَقَبَةِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Hazrat Umm Darda (RA) narrates, “I asked Hazrat Abu Darda (RA), “Why do you not also earn like others, in order to host your guests?’ “Ahead of you there is a difficult valley, which those carrying heavy loads cannot easily cross’ — I have heard the Prophet ﷺ say this; so I wish to lighten my load in order to cross that valley” he said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ هَانِيءٍ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ مَوْلَي عُثْمَانَ ﵁ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: كَانَ عُثْمَانُ إِذَا وَقَفَ عَلَي قَبْرٍ بَكَي حَتَّي يَبُلَّ لِحْيَتَهُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ: تُذْكَرُ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ فَلَا تَبْكِي وَتَبْكِي مِنْ هذَا؟ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْقَبْرَ أَوَّلُ مَنْزِلٍ مِنْ مَنَازِلِ اْلآخِرَةِ فَإِنْ نَجَا مِنْهُ فَمَا بَعْدَهُ أَيْسَرُ مِنْهُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَنْجُ مِنْهُ فَمَا بَعْدَهُ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ قَالَ: وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا رَأَيْتُ مَنْظَرًا قَطُّ إِلَّا وَالْقَبْرُ أَفْظَعُ مِنْهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب باب ماجاء في فظاعة القبر...، رقم:٢٣٠٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whenever Hazrat Uthman (RA) stood beside any grave, he would weep until his beard became wet. He was asked, “Even when Jannah and Jahannam are mentioned you do not weep this much, yet you weep this much on seeing a grave?’ “The grave is the first of the stations of the Hereafter; for one who attains salvation in it, the stations that follow become much easier than it, and for one who does not attain salvation at that station, the stations that come after become much harder than it” — I heard the Prophet ﷺ say this. And, “I have not seen any sight more frightening than the scene that takes place in the grave” —
